name: yt-dlb
description: YTDLB, a Bun/TypeScript downloader fork and migration of yt-dlp
author: yamada-sexta

scripts.lint:ts: biome lint index.ts ytdlb.ts yt_dlp test package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.format: biome format --write index.ts ytdlb.ts yt_dlp test package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome format index.ts ytdlb.ts yt_dlp test package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.lint:headers: rg --files -g '*.ts' yt_dlp ytdlb.ts | xargs -r awk 'FNR==1 && $0 !~ /^\/\/ Source:/ { print FILENAME ":" FNR ":" $0; failed=1 } END { exit failed }'
scripts.smoke:extractors: $npm_execpath -e "import { genExtractorClasses } from './yt_dlp/extractor/index.ts'; const classes = await genExtractorClasses(); console.log(classes.length);"
scripts.check: $npm_execpath run typecheck && $npm_execpath run lint:ts && $npm_execpath run lint:headers && $npm_execpath run smoke:extractors
scripts.clean:cache: find . \( -type d -name '.*_cache' -o -type d -name '__pycache__' -o -name '*.pyc' -o -name '*.class' -o -type d -name '.pytest_cache' -o -type d -name '.ruff_cache' \) -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
scripts.clean:all: bun run clean && bun run clean:test && bun run clean:cache
scripts.devscripts:issuetemplates: python3 devscripts/make_issue_template.py .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE_tmpl/1_broken_site.yml .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/1_broken_site.yml && python3 devscripts/make_issue_template.py .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE_tmpl/2_site_support_request.yml .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/2_site_support_request.yml && python3 devscripts/make_issue_template.py .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE_tmpl/3_site_feature_request.yml .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/3_site_feature_request.yml && python3 devscripts/make_issue_template.py .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE_tmpl/4_bug_report.yml .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/4_bug_report.yml && python3 devscripts/make_issue_template.py .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE_tmpl/5_feature_request.yml .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/5_feature_request.yml && python3 devscripts/make_issue_template.py .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE_tmpl/6_question.yml .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/6_question.yml
scripts.devscripts:completions: python3 devscripts/bash-completion.py && python3 devscripts/zsh-completion.py && python3 devscripts/fish-completion.py
scripts.devscripts:readme: COLUMNS=80 bun run ytdl --ignore-config --help | python3 devscripts/make_readme.py
